# sauth_code (Resource)

The code records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `owner_id` (String) organization id that owns the code

### Optional

- `code` (String, Sensitive) code value, generated when absent
- `count` (Number) number of redemptions, 0 for unlimited
- `ends_at` (String) last moment the code redeems
- `expires_at` (String) moment the code expires
- `starts_at` (String) first moment the code redeems
- `user_id` (String) user id the code is issued to, never with claim_id
